'''Kreshin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A fair-skinned Human with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Kreshin had her head shaved and a cranial implant installed.<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> she was part of the Imperial forces that worked to secure the captured [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] after the Empire [[Assault on Tython|raided]] the world, and she sliced the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Liam Dentiri]]'s training [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. However, she was slain defending the steps of the Temple from Republic forces.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Kreshin appears as the second boss of the Republic version of the Tactical Flashpoint "Assault on Tython," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.7: Invasion. For Imperial players, the second boss in Master Liam Dentiri, and the two share many of their game mechanics.<ref name="TOR" />
